# Variable `WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the timeout in seconds used by the `watchdog-config` recipe and also by `systemd` during reboot. The default is 60 seconds.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT)
